title: Open-Meteo historical archive – Auburn grid point, 20-28 June 2026
claims: The returned grid point is 38.9104 N, 121.0260 W at an elevation of 374 m.
Daily maximum temperature from 20 to 28 June 2026 ranged from 23.9 to 32.1 degrees C with a median of 29.6 degrees C.
Daily minimum temperature from 20 to 28 June 2026 ranged from 11.6 to 15.1 degrees C with a median of 13.6 degrees C.
One of the nine days had at least 1 mm of precipitation and none had at least 5 mm; 26 June recorded 1.9 mm and 27 June recorded 0.6 mm.
On 27 June 2026 the grid point recorded a maximum of 23.9 degrees C, a minimum of 13.6 degrees C and 0.6 mm of precipitation.
These are modelled grid-point values, not measurements taken on the race course.
